Our very first drones, caught on camera Back on January 18, 2026, update 0.0.11 of our browser prototype added Drones V1. A Wingman formation in rows of 2-2-4, moving smoothly around the ship and closing in as it turned. Free on Steam, link in bio.

Damage, shield, luck, each on its own timer Back on January 17, 2026, update 0.0.10 of our browser prototype reworked boosters. Sealed boosters, custom shortcuts to fire them, and a panel that counted every one down. Recorded at the time. Free on Steam, link in bio.
